title: Second-order Sinkhorn Geometry and $\sqrt{n}$-Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.36488v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased form of entropic optimal transport, has been widely used in various scientific disciplines due to its computational and statistical tractability. Unlike the Wasserstein distance, however, the Sinkhorn divergence is not a metric and it does not naturally admit a formal Riemannian structure. These properties are central to many applications of optimal transport methods that utilize interpolation, barycentric averaging, parallel transport or other geometric operations. Recent work addresses these shortcomings by constructing a formal Riemannian tangent space and a metric tensor on the space of probability measures that quadratically approximates the Sinkhorn divergence. In this work, we extend this framework with two major threads of contributions. For a suitable class of finite-smoothness cost functions, we prove Hadamard differentiability of the Sinkhorn metric tensor and we derive the Levi-Civita covar

translated_abstract: Sinkhorn散度是熵正则最优传输的一种去偏形式，因其计算与统计上的易处理性而被广泛应用于众多科学领域。然而，与Wasserstein距离不同，Sinkhorn散度既不是度量，也不自然地具有形式化的黎曼结构，而这些性质对于利用插值、重心平均、平行移动或其他几何操作的最优传输方法的许多应用至关重要。近期的工作通过在概率测度空间上构造一个形式化的黎曼切空间和度量张量（该度量张量对Sinkhorn散度进行二阶逼近）来弥补这些不足。在本工作中，我们从两条主线出发对这一框架进行了扩展。对于一类具有有限光滑性的代价函数，我们证明了Sinkhorn度量张量的Hadamard可微性，并推导出Levi-Civita协变
tldr: 本文将Sinkhorn散度的黎曼几何框架扩展至二阶，证明了Sinkhorn度量张量的Hadamard可微性并推导出Levi-Civita协变结构，从而支持√n速率的统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Riemannian geometry of the Sinkhorn divergence by proving Hadamard differentiability of the Sinkhorn metric tensor and deriving Levi-Civita covariant structures, enabling √n-rate statistical inference.
